title: CERT-In Advisory   CIAD-2026-0042
content:
CERT-In Advisory  
                                                                      CIAD-2026-0042
A End of Mainstream for Windows Server 2022
Original Issue Date: August    20, 2026
Software Affected
Windows Server 2022
Description
Microsoft has announced that Windows Server 2022 is approaching the end of its mainstream support lifecycle. On October 13, 2026, Windows Server 2022 will reach the end of mainstream support. The October 2026 security update will be the last mainstream support update available for this version.
Upon reaching the end of mainstream support, Windows Server 2022 will transition to extended support. This transition includes security updates at no additional cost, and the system will continue to receive monthly security updates through October 14, 2031.
To ensure environments remain fully supported under mainstream support, Microsoft recommends planning an upgrade to Windows Server 2025, which is the latest Long-Term Servicing Channel (LTSC) release.
